{{Quote|Did you hear about that new BT-16?|[[KE-829]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
This '''stormtrooper''' was stationed on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], shortly before its destruction in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
When the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was captured by the battlestation, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] heard this stormtrooper respond to [[KE-829]]'s question about the [[BT-16 perimeter droid|BT-16]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the popular non-[[canon]] comic series ''[[Star Wars: Tag & Bink]]'', it is retconned these two stormtroopers are Tag and Bink.
